item.title: 15 ms to 2.3 ms: an AI-driven hill climb on our calendar renderer
item.description: 36,500 events on an iPhone 14 Pro. Replacing the full-day view tree with reusable cells took Week scrolling from 15 ms to 2.3 ms of work per update and cut day preparation by 44%. What the agent changed, what we measured on the device, and what is still slow.
